name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
target_occupations: General citizens with savings bank accounts
required_docs: Duly completed and signed PMSBY claim form
Original or certified copy of Death Certificate (for accidental death claims)
Disability certificate issued by a competent Civil Surgeon / Government Medical Board
First Information Report (FIR) or Panchnama / Police inquest report
Post-Mortem Examination (PME) report (for death cases)
Aadhaar card copy of the insured and nominee
Copy of bank passbook or cancelled cheque proving auto-debit of premium
exclusions: Natural death due to illness, disease, cardiac arrest, or old age
Suicide, attempted suicide, or intentional self-inflicted injury
Routine in-patient or out-patient hospitalization costs and medical bills
Accidents occurring while under the influence of intoxicating alcohol, liquor, or drugs
Death or injury arising from participation in criminal or unlawful activities
War, invasion, rebellion, hostilities, or nuclear contamination
covered_highlights: ₹2,00,000 benefit payable upon accidental death
₹2,00,000 benefit for permanent total disability (loss of both eyes or loss of use of both hands or feet, or loss of sight of one eye and loss of use of one hand/foot)
₹1,00,000 benefit for permanent partial disability (total and irrecoverable loss of sight of one eye or loss of use of one hand or foot)
Extremely affordable ₹20/year auto-debited in a single installment from subscriber's savings bank account
Worldwide 24x7 accidental coverage for active bank account holders
not_covered_highlights: Any natural death or non-accidental mortality
Routine hospitalization fees, surgeon bills, and post-discharge medicines
plain_summary: A government-backed micro-insurance scheme providing ₹2,00,000 accidental death and permanent total disability cover (and ₹1,00,000 for partial disability) for just ₹20 per year for individuals aged 18 to 70 with an active savings bank account. Routine hospitalization is strictly excluded.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
target_occupations: Salaried and non-salaried bank account holders
required_docs: Duly completed PMJJBY claim form and discharge receipt signed by nominee
Original or certified copy of Death Certificate
Aadhaar card copy of the deceased policyholder and claimant nominee
Bank passbook copy or cancelled cheque of the nominee for direct benefit transfer
Proof of bank account auto-debit of premium for the relevant policy year
exclusions: Death due to non-accidental causes occurring within the initial 30-day lien period from enrollment date
Claims beyond ₹2,00,000 in case of multiple bank accounts/policies held by the same individual
Coverage terminates upon the policyholder attaining age 55 or closure of bank account
Fraudulent misrepresentation or identity mismatch
covered_highlights: ₹2,00,000 pure life insurance benefit payable to nominee upon death of subscriber due to any cause (natural, medical, or accidental)
Pro-rata quarterly premium structure for mid-year joiners: ₹436 (June–Aug), ₹342 (Sept–Nov), ₹228 (Dec–Feb), and ₹114 (Mar–May)
Seamless auto-debit renewal through bank/post office account
Renewable annually up to age 55 for individuals enrolled before age 50
not_covered_highlights: Non-accidental deaths occurring within the first 30 days of initial enrollment (30-day lien window)
Hospitalization expenses, outpatient treatment, or critical illness treatment bills
Maturity bonuses or surrender value (pure term life insurance without investment returns)
plain_summary: A government-administered pure term life insurance scheme granting ₹2,00,000 death coverage for any cause of death to individuals aged 18 to 50 for an annual premium of ₹436 (with quarterly pro-rata enrollment slabs of ₹436/₹342/₹228/₹114), subject to a 30-day initial lien period on non-accidental deaths.

special_rules.lien_clause: 30-day waiting period (lien) applies to non-accidental deaths from enrollment date; accidental deaths covered from day one.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
required_docs: Crop insurance intimation form submitted within 72 hours of localized casualty
Land Record Documents (Record of Rights / 7/12 extract / Patta / Land possession certificate)
Sowing Certificate / Crop Declaration verified by Village Revenue Officer (Patwari / VAO)
Tenant agreement or sharecropper declaration (for non-owner cultivators)
Bank passbook copy linked to Aadhaar showing premium deduction or receipt
Geo-tagged photographs of localized crop inundation/hail damage (where required)
exclusions: Crop loss intimated after 72 hours of occurrence for localized calamities
Losses arising from war, nuclear risks, civil commotion, or malicious destruction
Damage post-harvest caused by theft, arson, or stray cattle grazing
Storage losses in godowns or premises outside the drying field
Unapproved crop varieties or avoidable farmer negligence
covered_highlights: Farmer premium strictly capped: 2.0% of Sum Insured for Kharif food/oilseed crops, 1.5% for Rabi food/oilseed crops, and 5.0% for commercial/horticultural crops
Balance actuarial premium subsidized equally by Central and State Governments
Comprehensive risk coverage: Prevented sowing, mid-season adversity, standing crop yield loss, and localized risks (hailstorm, landslide, inundation, cloudburst)
14-day post-harvest cover for cut-and-spread crops drying in fields against unseasonal/cyclonic rainfall
Strict 72-hour localized calamity intimation rule via mobile app or toll-free national helpline 14447
not_covered_highlights: Localized calamity claims reported after the 72-hour window
Field produce damaged beyond the 14-day post-harvest drying period
plain_summary: National comprehensive crop insurance safeguarding farmers against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to 14 days post-harvest. Farmer premium share is capped at 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops, with mandatory 72-hour localized calamity intimation via the 14447 national helpline.

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
target_occupations: Urban occupational categories (ragpickers, domestic helpers, street vendors, security guards, construction workers)
Senior citizens aged 70 years and above across India (universal entitlement)
required_docs: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY e-Card / ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) ID
Aadhaar card of patient / beneficiary
Ration card or government family identification document
Hospital IPD admission slip and treatment pre-authorization generated by Ayushman Mitra
Discharge summary with diagnostic reports and pharmacy logs
exclusions: Standalone Out-Patient Department (OPD) clinic consultations and retail medicine purchases
Cosmetic, plastic, or aesthetic procedures not related to post-trauma reconstruction
Fertility treatments, IVF, and surrogate procedures
Hospitalization in non-empanelled facilities except in life-threatening certified emergencies
Diagnostic investigations conducted without hospital admission or in-patient justification
covered_highlights: ₹5,00,000 cashless and paperless annual healthcare assurance per eligible family for secondary and tertiary hospitalization
100% premium funded by Central and State Governments (₹0 premium for beneficiaries)
Day-one coverage for all pre-existing medical conditions with zero waiting period
Includes 3 days pre-hospitalization and 15 days post-hospitalization diagnostics and medication
Senior Citizen Universal Top-Up: Dedicated ₹5,00,000 distinct cover for all individuals aged 70+ (Ayushman Vay Vandana Card)
Portability across 29,000+ empanelled public and private hospitals nationwide
not_covered_highlights: Standalone OPD consultations and routine pharmacy bills
Elective cosmetic surgeries, routine vision correction, and dental checkups
Admissions in unaccredited, non-empanelled private nursing homes
plain_summary: The world's largest government-financed health assurance program, offering ₹5,00,000 cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization coverage per family annually at ₹0 premium, featuring day-one pre-existing disease cover and a special ₹5,00,000 top-up for seniors aged 70+. Standalone OPD bills are strictly excluded.

name: Gig-Worker Micro-Health Clinic Shield
target_occupations: Quick commerce delivery partners (Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart)
Ride-hailing bike & cab drivers (Ola, Uber, Rapido)
Logistics and courier delivery couriers (Delhivery, Shadowfax)
required_docs: Gig platform driver/delivery partner active profile screenshot or ID card
Consultation prescription from a licensed MBBS/MD practitioner
Itemized diagnostic laboratory bills and clinical treatment summary
Itemized pharmacy invoice showing doctor-prescribed acute illness medications
Aadhaar card copy
UPI ID / Bank details for direct reimbursement transfer within 24 hours
exclusions: Cosmetic, aesthetic, dermatological anti-aging, or weight-loss procedures
Nutritional dietary supplements, multi-vitamins, tonics, and protein powders without documented acute medical deficiency
Routine dental cleaning, scaling, orthodontic braces, and root canals (except emergency trauma repairs)
Inpatient hospitalizations exceeding 24 hours (requiring standard comprehensive hospitalization cover)
Non-accidental illnesses diagnosed during the initial 15-day waiting period
covered_highlights: Designed specifically for gig platform riders: ₹49/month micro-subscription (₹588 annual equivalent)
₹5,000 per-claim ceiling for outpatient clinic consultations, acute day-care procedures, and prescription meds
₹10,000 aggregate annual policy limit across multiple claims
Rapid UPI-based digital reimbursement settled within 24 to 48 hours
15-day initial waiting period for medical sickness; road accident trauma injuries covered from minute one
not_covered_highlights: Cosmetic procedures, multi-vitamins, and routine dental care
Any single claim exceeding ₹5,000 or cumulative yearly claims above ₹10,000
Medical illness occurring during the first 15 days of policy enrollment
plain_summary: A representative IRDAI-aligned micro-health insurance policy customized for platform gig workers and delivery executives. For ₹49/month (₹588/year), it provides up to ₹5,000 per claim and a ₹10,000 annual cap for clinic consultations, minor trauma treatments, and acute illness prescriptions, with a 15-day waiting period and clear exclusions on cosmetic treatments, vitamins, and routine dental care.
